description: Fixture catalog for pass unit tests: two fake sources, 12 tools, including noise tools (ping/debug), an ambiguous find/search pair, and a chain-shaped trio.

finco.name: find_companies
finco.description: Find companies. Search for companies. Returns companies matching the query. This tool finds companies.

finco.name: find_events
finco.description: Find events for a company. Can also search events. Events include earnings calls and conferences and other events.

finco.name: search_transcripts
finco.description: Search transcripts. Searches within event transcripts for text. May be confused with find_events which finds the events themselves.

repohub.name: search_repositories
repohub.description: Search repositories on the platform using a query string with optional qualifiers.

repohub.name: list_repositories
repohub.description: List repositories for a user or organization. Not a search; returns all repositories.

repohub.name: get_file_contents
repohub.description: Get the contents of a file in a repository.

repohub.name: list_issues
repohub.description: List issues in a repository with optional filters for state and labels.

repohub.name: search_issues
repohub.description: Search issues across repositories. Similar to list_issues but query-driven.

repohub.name: admin_enterprise_stats
repohub.description: Get enterprise server statistics. Requires site admin.
